ZONING NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE-1 MAP AMENDMENT
10301-47 SOUTH TORRENCE AVENUE

Narrative:

The Applicants, Lariba Group, LLC and ATG, LLC, are seeking a map amendment from C2-1 Type-1
Motor Vehicle Related Commercial District to that of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle Related Commercial District
in order to allow the construction of a proposed 1 Story Retail Shopping Center and 128 parking spaces,
with on-site out-door storage uses of Vehicles.

The property has improvement of a 2,244.44 sq. ft. one story brick building with fast food restaurant 260
feet south of 103 street. Also south and east of the one story building are two fenced cell towers.

Applicants are seeking to develop a 6,346 sq. ft. Retail Shopping Center with 34 off-street parking spaces
and 4 ADA parking spaces 315 feet south of 103" street.

The applicants also are seeking to develop a parking lot Zero feet south of 103" street with 94 off-street
parking spaces and (1) ADA parking space to be used for the customers and the business of the proposed
6,346 sq. ft. Retail center building.

* Lot Area to be redeveloped: 83,955 sq. ft.

* Buildings Size: Existing 2,224.44 + Proposed 6,346.48
Total Building Size: 8,592.95 sq. ft.

(a) Floor Area Ratio: 0.12

(b) Density: No residential Not applicable.

(c) Off-Street Parking: 128 on-site parking spaces.

(d) Setbacks: Front:51.26ft North Side:260 ft.

Rear:71.17 ft. South Side 5.0 ft.
(e) Building Height: 21 feet and 4 inches. (Proposed)
